title: Agrifood LCA (proposal) - AgriFootprintResult
description: Environmental footprint of one AgriCropCycle (cradle to farm gate), with method metadata so results from different calculators stay comparable.

calculationMethod.description: Property. Models and emission factors used (e.g. 'IPCC 2019 Tier 1').

ghgEmissionsPerArea.description: Property. Greenhouse-gas emissions per hectare on the mineral-soil basis comparable to published product footprints (excl. drained peat, SOC change, LUC). Units:'kg CO2e/ha'.

carbonFootprint.description: Property. Carbon footprint per functional unit (sub-property functionalUnit). Units:'kg CO2e/t'.

functionalUnit.description: Property. Sub-property of carbonFootprint, e.g. '1 t harvested raw product'.

emissionBreakdown.description: Property. Emissions by source: fertiliserProduction, fieldN2O, dieselAndIrrigation, pesticideProduction, seed, liming, drainedOrganicSoil (kg CO2e/ha).

nitrogenSurplus.description: Property. Field N balance (inputs incl. fixation − removal); eutrophication proxy. Units:'kg N/ha'.

phosphorusSurplus.description: Property. Field P balance. Units:'kg P/ha'.

blueWaterFootprint.description: Property. Irrigation water per tonne. Units:'m3/t'.

imputationMethod.description: Property. Sub-property, only when dataOrigin=imputed. E.g. 'gradientBoosting', 'knn', 'cropRegionMedian'.

imputationModel.description: Property. Sub-property. Identifier/version of the model that produced the value.

confidenceInterval.description: Property. Sub-property. {'lower': n, 'upper': n, 'level': 0.8} for imputed/estimated values.

nonFlagEmissions.description: Property. Energy/industrial (non-FLAG) emissions: fertiliser and pesticide production, fuel, seed. Units:'kg CO2e/ha'.

flagLandManagementEmissions.description: Property. FLAG land-management emissions: field N2O, liming, drained organic soils, soil carbon losses. Units:'kg CO2e/ha'.

flagLandUseChangeEmissions.description: Property. FLAG direct land-use change emissions, amortised over 20 years. Units:'kg CO2e/ha'.

flagRemovals.description: Property. FLAG removals (soil carbon gains). Reported separately, never netted silently against emissions. Units:'kg CO2e/ha'.

soilCarbonStockChange.description: Property. Soil organic carbon stock change, mineral soils 0-30 cm (+ = gain). Units:'t C/ha/yr'.

flagNetCarbonFootprint.description: Property. (non-FLAG + FLAG emissions - removals) per functional unit; informative. Units:'kg CO2e/t'.
